Thank you for downloading Fitness Buddy, the ultimate fitness journal with tons of amazing content: 1700+ exercises, 1000+ HD videos, 75+ tailored workouts, 4000+ retina display images and animations, all in the palm of your hands!

 If you have any comments/suggestions/feedback feel free to email us at support@fitnessbuddyapp.com

As always, please consult your physician before making any changes to the way you manage your health. The usage of the Fitness Buddy application also constitutes agreement to the license found within the Setting menu.

Thank you for making Fitness Buddy the #1 workout app on the market. We couldn't have done it without you! Version 3.10 features the introduction of workout plans to help you reach your fitness goals sooner, along with Google Fit integration. If you've enjoyed using Fitness Buddy, please show us some love by rating us 5 stars on the app store!
